name: dogfood-mysql-rls-tenant-app
description: Dogfood app (v1.32-3) — a Nuxt 3 + Prisma + MySQL 8 multi-tenant SaaS with row-level security policies + automatic tenant_id injection + cross-tenant refuse + bypass_rls audit trail + testcontainers-driven fidelity harness + v2 advanced db semantics (MySQL 8 group replication + binlog advance / GTID / ROW format / gap detect + MySQL Router R/W split via pool advanced + MySQL 8 + Router testcontainers duck-typing) driven by @kiwa-test/orm v0.10 in KIWA_MODE=mock and testcontainers MySQL 8 in KIWA_MODE=real (env-skip MYSQL_KEY). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics release gate + Playwright e2e for tenant / cross-tenant / bypass / audit / group-replication / binlog-advance / router-split / testcontainers-probe flows.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/orm -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
